<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 233.963 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 232.956 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 peak at ~ 24 % intensity) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom (35Cl/37Cl). Solving for a formula CₓH_yO_zCl that matches this mass yields C₇H₂O₇Cl (calculated neutral mass = 232.9489 Da, within typical experimental error). This fits the observed isotopic distribution and the required format.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H2O7Cl</final_answer>
